description: Records the person's answer to the current question of a mock interview and checks its structure with the rules of check_interview_answer. Returns a compact verdict and what comes next: a follow-up probe for what the answer does not show (own action, a result in numbers, the figure before, one specific example), or the next question. skip moves on without an answer. An answer in another language is recorded and checked as its literal English translation (text_en) sent with it. Contact details are removed first. Requires sign-in with a PM Career Desk account that has an Interview Coach Pass.

answer.description: The person's answer to the current question or follow-up, exactly as given.
answer.title: Answer

lang.description: The language the person writes in, as a code such as es, fr or ru; empty or en for English. The result names this language; findings are written in English.
lang.title: Lang

skip.description: True moves on to the next question without an answer.
skip.title: Skip

text_en.description: Only when the text is not in English: a literal English translation of it, word for word, with no fact added or left out and figures and names as written. The fixed rules read this translation, and the result says so.
text_en.title: Text En

turn.description: Optional. The turn number of the question being answered; a repeated turn returns the same reply without recording the answer twice. 0 when not known.
turn.title: Turn

name: answer_mock_question
title: Answer a mock interview question
